title: Representatives in a colimit in a concrete category
statement: Let C be a concrete category, F : J ⥤ C a diagram, and D a cocone on F with a colimit witness hD : IsColimit D [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Assume PreservesColimit F (forget C): the forgetful functor preserves the colimit of this particular diagram. Every element x : ToType D.pt has a representative: there exist j : J and y : ToType (F.obj j) with D.ι.app j y = x. No filteredness assumption on J is required.

proof.text: Apply CategoryTheory.Limits.Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep to the colimit cocone and the element x.
